[SWS_DM_01207] Get Authentication State
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04240
⌈
If the application calls the
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication::GetState
method of the class
ara::diag::ClientAuthentication
, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall return the current Authentication State of the Client.
